npcDex.en: Every GUDMON you catch goes into the GUDDEX. Press START to see it.

npcCosplay.en: I came dressed as BIG CLIENT. Nobody laughed.

profProgress.en: You have {b} of {B} badges and {c} of {C} GUDMON. Great work!
